title: Weekly Bulletin — the site as it is today

callouts.text: Only ever this week's. There is now a Bulletins page listing the past ones, which opens on the most recent.

Getting this to the printer meant re-typing the whole thing into a Google Doc and converting that to a PDF by hand. It is one button now — four 5.5 x 8.5 pages, ready as they are. If we ever wanted an eight-page bulletin, that is automatic as well — it prints as many pages as there are.
Service times, typed in each week. Filled in automatically now.
The Epistle and Gospel, looked up and typed in each week. Taken from the OCA lectionary automatically now.
